content.short: iZiSwap is a multi-chain DL-AMM DEX offering efficient concentrated liquidity and limit orders.
content.description:
iZiSwap is an advanced multi-chain decentralized exchange powered by iZUMi Finance, utilizing a unique Discretized-Liquidity AMM (DL-AMM) model. This innovative design allows for more precise concentrated liquidity, making it highly efficient for stablecoin swaps and on-chain limit orders. Operating across major networks like Linea, Scroll, and Mantle, iZiSwap serves as a primary liquidity hub, providing users with professional-grade trading tools and minimal slippage.

The platform is designed to be highly interoperable, frequently participating in ecosystem-wide incentive programs to reward liquidity providers with "iPoints." By leveraging discretized price ticks, iZiSwap delivers the speed and precision of an order book within a fully decentralized framework. As a key component of the cross-chain DeFi landscape, iZiSwap empowers users to trade ecosystem tokens with superior capital efficiency and transparent on-chain execution.
